content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The architecture behind selling design assets with crypto payments involves leveraging decentralized technology to create a self-sufficient e-commerce platform. Unlike conventional methods that rely on payment gateways like Stripe, which are often unavailable in certain regions, this approach enables creators to maintain complete control over their sales. By utilizing tools such as NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can minimize fees and maximize revenue, addressing a critical gap in the digital marketplace.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

This infrastructure is built upon a combination of free and open-source tools that facilitate the entire sales process. For hosting, creators can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The backend logic is executed via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring seamless functionality. Order storage is handled through Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery is managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments integrates into this architecture to enable automatic crypto payment verification, ensuring that transactions are secure and efficient.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in emerging markets where traditional payment platforms have failed to provide adequate service. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, or design templates, this infrastructure allows you to tap into a global audience without the restrictions imposed by conventional payment systems. By adopting this architecture, creators can build their own digital storefronts, empowering them with the tools they need to thrive in a competitive landscape.
Reduce transaction fees to 0.5% with NOWPayments compared to 10% on Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include a secure hosting platform, a flexible backend for logic processing, and a robust payment solution. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the foundation for your online store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the necessary backend logic. Supabase provides reliable order storage, and NOWPayments facilitates immediate crypto transactions. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that supports various digital products, allowing creators to focus on what they do best—creating.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and set up your online store. Next, configure the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle product delivery and order processing. Then, integrate Supabase or Google Sheets for storing order data. Finally, implement NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to deploy and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Retain full ownership of your digital products with no platform dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you want to explore how to effectively sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates needed to build and deploy your own digital commerce stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell ebooks by using a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This architecture allows for direct sales without relying on conventional payment platforms.

Utilizing a combination of free hosting and backend services along with NOWPayments can help you sell digital downloads effectively while minimizing platform fees. This approach allows you to retain more revenue from each sale.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating your own digital store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. By integrating with NOWPayments, you can accept crypto payments directly, eliminating the need for platforms like Gumroad.
What are the costs associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a nominal fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than many traditional platforms that may charge up to 10%. This cost-effective solution helps you retain more of your earnings.
How can I ensure my digital products are delivered automatically?

You can automate product delivery by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which can handle the backend logic for delivering products immediately upon successful payment confirmation through NOWPayments.
